slideDistance.$description: Slide: how far the dialog travels in and out.

scaleFrom.$description: Scale and Blur: the dialog's size as it starts to appear.

popFrom.$description: Pop: starting size before it springs past full size and settles.

originFrom.$description: From the button: starting size, at the button that opened it.

flipAngle.$description: Flip: how far the dialog is turned as it starts to appear.

swingAngle.$description: Swing: how far the dialog is turned on its hinge edge.

perspective.$description: Viewing distance for Flip and Swing.

blurFrom.$description: Blur: how blurred the dialog is as it starts to appear.
